articles.title: Crypto campaign fund Fairshake faces $2 million setback in Florida primaries
articles.snippet: In a race that drew criticism to crypto's leading political action committee for featuring fake headlines in ads, Fairshake's expensive effort fell short.

articles.title: BitGo Korea secures VASP registration for institutional crypto custody
articles.snippet: Regulators reportedly accepted BitGo Korea’s registration on Tuesday, two days before stricter VASP entry requirements took effect.

articles.title: Crypto PAC notches primary wins, but loses $2M Florida race
articles.snippet: A Fairshake spokesperson said that the PAC was “just getting started“ on its expenditures as part of efforts to fill US Congress with lawmakers friendly to the crypto industry.

articles.title: OCC head promises final GENIUS rules by November
articles.snippet: The US banking regulator released a 376‑page proposal in February, calling for public comment on rules to implement the stablecoin bill ahead of its January 2027 effective date.

articles.title: Standard Chartered analyst eyes $100K BTC as US Treasury doubles long-end buybacks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s rebound toward $69,000 is gaining momentum as Geoff Kendrick points to improving liquidity conditions and a potential cycle bottom.
